tools.name: generate-dbml-schema
tools.description:
Generates DBML (Database Markup Language) schema from Dataverse entities.

Accepts solution names, explicit entity lists, or both. Returns DBML text
and a clickable dbdiagram.io URL for visualization.

DBML output includes:
- Table definitions with columns and types
- Primary key markers [pk]
- Foreign key relationships (Ref: statements) for all lookups

Example output:
```dbml
Table new_directdebit {
    new_directdebitid uniqueidentifier [pk]
    new_name nvarchar
    new_accountid lookup
}
Ref: new_directdebit.new_accountid > account.accountid
```

solutions.description: One or more solution unique names to extract entities from

entities.description: Explicit list of entity logical names to include

includeSystemColumns.description: Include system columns like createdon, modifiedon (default: false)

prefix.description: Only include columns matching this prefix (e.g., "si_")

depth.description: Relationship traversal depth for discovering related entities (default: 0)

tools.name: get-service-endpoints
tools.description:
Get all service endpoints (webhooks, Azure Service Bus, REST) configured in the environment.

Service endpoints are external URLs that Dataverse can call via SDK message processing steps.
Use this to discover outbound integration touchpoints.

Optionally validate endpoint URLs against required patterns (e.g. your organization's domains).
Flagged endpoints are those whose URLs do NOT match any of the provided patterns.

Returns:
- Endpoint name, full URL, contract type (OneWay/TwoWay/Queue/Topic/REST/EventHub/Webhook/EventGrid)
- Authentication type (Anonymous/HttpHeader/WebKey/SASKey/etc.)
- Number of SDK message steps using each endpoint
- Summary statistics by type and auth method
- Flagged endpoints (when requiredUrlStrings provided)

requiredUrlStrings.description:
URL patterns to validate against. Endpoints not matching any pattern are flagged.

Examples:
  - Validate production URLs: `["mycompany.com"]`
  - Multiple environments: `["prod.mycompany.com", "staging.mycompany.com"]`

outputFormat.description:
Output format

Examples:
  - Compact (flagged items and stats only): `summary`
  - All details (default): `full`

excludeOotb.description: Exclude Microsoft out-of-the-box (OOTB) components from results (default: true). Set to false to include all items.

tools.name: get-webhook-registrations
tools.description:
Get all webhook-type SDK message processing steps in the environment.

Webhooks are registrations that call external service endpoints when Dataverse events occur.
This identifies inbound integration patterns where external systems receive notifications.

Returns:
- Webhook name and endpoint URL
- Trigger entity and message (Create/Update/Delete)
- Filtering attributes and execution stage
- Enabled/disabled status
- Summary by entity and message type

excludeOotb.description: Exclude Microsoft out-of-the-box (OOTB) components from results (default: true). Set to false to include all items.

tools.name: analyze-flow-complexity
tools.description:
Analyze Power Automate flow complexity and calculate risk scores.

Now includes URL extraction and hardcoded secret detection per flow.

Complexity scoring factors:
- Action count (base complexity)
- Unique connectors (integration surface, +2 each)
- HTTP/REST connectors (external dependency, +5 each)
- Premium connectors (licensing concern, +3 each)
- Conditions/switches (+2 each)
- Loops (+3 each)
- Parallel branches (+3 each)
- Error handling scopes (+1 each)

Risk levels: Low (0-20), Medium (21-50), High (51-100), Critical (>100)

Use flowId to analyze a single flow, or omit to analyze all flows.

flowId.description: Specific flow ID to analyze (omit for all flows)

maxFlows.description: Maximum flows to analyze when flowId not specified (default: 0 = unlimited)

outputFormat.description:
Output format

Examples:
  - Compact (flagged items and stats only): `summary`
  - All details (default): `full`

excludeOotb.description: Exclude Microsoft out-of-the-box (OOTB/managed) flows from analysis (default: true). Set to false to include all flows.

tools.name: gen-integration-audit
tools.description:
Generate a comprehensive integration audit report for the PowerPlatform environment.

This top-down report aggregates all integration touchpoints:

OUTBOUND: Service endpoints, flows with HTTP/external calls, plugins with external access
INBOUND: Webhook registrations, flows with external triggers
COMPLEXITY: Flow complexity scores, risk levels, URL extraction, secret detection
ENVIRONMENT: Environment variable inventory with URL validation
PLUGINS: Plugin assembly inventory

Includes URL validation (flag endpoints/variables not matching required patterns),
hardcoded secret detection in flows, and environment variable analysis.

Returns a pre-formatted Markdown report. Use outputFormat="summary" for a compact view.

maxRecords.description: Maximum records to return for service endpoints, webhooks, and plugin assemblies (default: 100). Increase to get all items in large environments.

Examples:
  - Sequential 5-digit: `{SEQNUM:5}`
  - Invoice prefix: `INV-{SEQNUM:6}`
  - Date + sequence: `{DATETIMEUTC:yyyyMMdd}-{SEQNUM:4}`

commentText.description: The comment text in Markdown format. Use standard Markdown syntax: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, - lists, [links](url), etc. Will be auto-converted to HTML if AZUREDEVOPS_COMMENT_FORMAT=html is set.

tools.name: update-work-item-comment
tools.description: Update an existing comment on a work item in Azure DevOps (requires AZUREDEVOPS_ENABLE_WORK_ITEM_WRITE=true). By default, comments are sent as Markdown. For orgs without Markdown preview, set AZUREDEVOPS_COMMENT_FORMAT=html to auto-convert Markdown to HTML.

commentId.description: The comment ID to update. Get comment IDs from get-work-item-comments.

commentText.description: The updated comment text in Markdown format. Use standard Markdown syntax: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, - lists, [links](url), etc. Will be auto-converted to HTML if AZUREDEVOPS_COMMENT_FORMAT=html is set.

tools.name: update-work-item
tools.description: Update a work item in Azure DevOps using JSON Patch operations (requires AZUREDEVOPS_ENABLE_WORK_ITEM_WRITE=true). Auto-injects markdown format operations for large text fields.

op.description: The operation type: 'add' (set value), 'replace' (update existing), or 'remove' (clear field)

value.description: The value to set (not required for 'remove' operation)

patchOperations.description:
Array of JSON Patch operations. Each operation specifies what to change.

Examples:
  - Update state: `{ "op": "replace", "path": "/fields/System.State", "value": "Active" }`
  - Set description: `{ "op": "add", "path": "/fields/System.Description", "value": "Content here" }`
  - Clear assignee: `{ "op": "remove", "path": "/fields/System.AssignedTo" }`

skipAutoConvert.description: Skip automatic markdown format injection for large text fields. Only use when explicitly requested. Default: false

tools.name: create-work-item
tools.description: Create a new work item in Azure DevOps with optional parent relationship (requires AZUREDEVOPS_ENABLE_WORK_ITEM_WRITE=true)

workItemType.description: The work item type: 'Bug', 'Task', 'User Story', 'Feature', 'Epic', or custom types

fields.description:
Object with field values. Required: System.Title. Common fields: System.Description, System.State, System.AssignedTo, Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria, Microsoft.VSTS.TCM.ReproSteps (bugs).

Examples:
  - Bug with details: `{"System.Title": "Login fails on mobile", "System.Description": "Steps to reproduce...", "Microsoft.VSTS.TCM.ReproSteps": "1. Open app..."}`
  - User Story: `{"System.Title": "As a user, I want to...", "Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria": "Given... When... Then..."}`
  - Task: `{"System.Title": "Implement API endpoint", "System.Description": "Details...", "Microsoft.VSTS.Scheduling.OriginalEstimate": 4}`

parentId.description: Optional parent work item ID (for creating child items). Simplified alternative to relations parameter.

relations.description: Optional array of work item relationships. Use parentId for simple parent-child relationships.

tools.name: upload-work-item-attachment
tools.description: Upload a local file to ADO as a work item attachment and return the attachment URL (requires AZUREDEVOPS_ENABLE_WORK_ITEM_WRITE=true). Embed the returned URL in an tag inside any HTML field or comment to reference the file. When workItemId is provided, the upload is recorded in that work item's local .attachments.json so the next sync push knows the file already exists in ADO.

filePath.description:
Absolute path to the local file to upload. Common case: a screenshot taken by Playwright or a saved evidence file.

Examples:
  - Playwright screenshot for evidence: `/tmp/playwright-screenshot.png`
  - Local repro recording: `/Users/me/Desktop/bug-repro.gif`
  - Tied to a work item (auto-records in manifest): `filePath: "/tmp/evidence.png", workItemId: 73702`

workItemId.description: Optional work item ID to associate the upload with. When provided, the attachment is recorded in that work item's local manifest so subsequent sync push operations recognise it as already on ADO.

fileName.description: Optional override for the filename ADO will store. Defaults to the basename of filePath.

tools.name: delete-work-item
tools.description: Delete a work item in Azure DevOps (requires AZUREDEVOPS_ENABLE_WORK_ITEM_DELETE=true)

tools.name: list-repositories
tools.description: List all Git repositories in an Azure DevOps project. Returns repository ID, name, default branch, and URLs.

tools.name: list-pull-requests
tools.description: List pull requests in a Git repository. Filter by status (active, completed, abandoned, all). Returns PR ID, title, author, branches, and review status.

tools.name: get-pull-request
tools.description: Get details of a specific pull request including title, description, author, reviewers with votes, and merge status.

tools.name: get-pull-request-threads
tools.description: Get all comment threads and discussions on a pull request. Includes inline code comments with file paths and line numbers.

tools.name: get-pull-request-commits
tools.description: Get all commits included in a pull request. Shows commit ID, message, author, and date.

tools.name: get-pull-request-changes
tools.description: Get file changes (diffs) in a pull request. Shows added, modified, deleted, and renamed files with their paths.

tools.name: get-build-status
tools.description: Get build status and details. Use detail='summary' for basic status, 'timeline' for step breakdown (default scope='problems' shows only failed/warning items), or 'full' for logs. The timelineScope controls what records are included: 'problems' (default, only errors/warnings), 'stages' (minimal), 'jobs' (moderate), 'all' (everything).

detail.description: Level of detail: 'summary' (default), 'timeline' (include steps), or 'full' (include logs)

timelineScope.description: Timeline scope: 'problems' (default, only errors/warnings/failures), 'stages' (minimal), 'jobs' (moderate), 'all' (everything - may be large)

maxIssues.description: Maximum issues per record (default: 5, prioritizes errors over warnings)

tools.name: get-build-timeline
tools.description: Get step-by-step breakdown of a build. Shows stages, jobs, and tasks with timing, status, and error/warning counts. Use scope to control output size: 'problems' (default, only errors/warnings), 'stages' (minimal), 'jobs' (moderate), 'all' (everything). Always includes summary stats regardless of scope.

scope.description: Filter scope: 'problems' (default, only errors/warnings/failures), 'stages' (minimal), 'jobs' (moderate), 'all' (everything - may be large)

maxIssues.description: Maximum issues per record (default: 5, prioritizes errors over warnings)

tools.name: get-build-logs
tools.description: Get build logs. Without logId, returns list of available logs with line counts. With logId, returns that log's content filtered by mode to reduce noise from progress indicators.

logId.description: Optional specific log ID to retrieve content

mode.description: Filter mode: 'summary' (default) removes progress indicators like 'Receiving objects: 1%', 'full' returns everything, 'errors' shows only errors/warnings

tools.name: list-variable-groups
tools.description: List all variable groups in an Azure DevOps project. Variable groups store values and secrets used in pipelines.

tools.name: get-variable-group
tools.description: Get a specific variable group by ID from Azure DevOps. Returns all variables (secrets are masked).

tools.name: sync-work-item-to-file
tools.description:
Download work item(s) from ADO and save as local markdown file(s). Token-efficient for editing. READ-ONLY: HTML fields are converted to Markdown in the LOCAL FILE only — ADO is never modified. If a field with an HTML table is converted, a lossy-conversion warning is returned; re-read the original with get-work-item before editing it. Can also pull all child work items under a parent (e.g., all User Stories under a Feature).

Examples:
  - Pull single work item: `workItemIds: [1044]`
  - Pull multiple work items: `workItemIds: [1044, 1045, 1046]`
  - Pull all User Stories under Feature: `parentId: 12345`
  - Pull all Bugs under Feature: `parentId: 12345, childType: "Bug"`

workItemIds.description: Work item IDs to pull (optional if using parentId)

parentId.description: Pull all child work items of this parent (e.g., Feature ID to pull all User Stories)

childType.description: Filter by work item type when using parentId (default: 'User Story'). Common values: 'User Story', 'Bug', 'Task'

folder.description: Override folder path (default: docs/user-stories or AZUREDEVOPS_SYNC_FOLDER)

skipAutoConvert.description: Skip automatic HTML-to-markdown conversion. Only use when explicitly requested. Default: false (auto-convert enabled)

tools.name: sync-work-item-from-file
tools.description:
Upload local markdown changes back to ADO. Auto-detects new_*.md files and creates them as new work items. Auto-converts HTML fields to markdown. Requires AZUREDEVOPS_ENABLE_WORK_ITEM_WRITE=true.

Examples:
  - Push specific work items: `workItemIds: [1044, 1045]`
  - Auto-create new work items: `project: "MyProject" (auto-detects new_*.md files)`

workItemIds.description: Work item IDs to push (optional - new_*.md files are auto-detected)

folder.description: Override folder path (default: docs/user-stories or AZUREDEVOPS_SYNC_FOLDER)

skipAutoConvert.description: Skip automatic HTML-to-markdown conversion. Only use when explicitly requested. Default: false (auto-convert enabled)

tools.name: check-work-item-markdown
tools.description: Check if work item fields are markdown (required for sync) or HTML format.

tools.name: list-synced-work-items
tools.description: List work items that have been synced to local markdown files.

folder.description: Override folder path (default: docs/user-stories or AZUREDEVOPS_SYNC_FOLDER)

tools.name: create-work-item-file
tools.description:
Create a new work item template file locally for any type (User Story, Bug, Feature, Epic, Task, etc.). The file can be edited and then pushed to ADO using sync-work-item-from-file. Parent is optional - omit for standalone items like Features or Epics.

Examples:
  - User Story under Feature: `project: "MyProject", parentId: 12345, workItemType: "User Story"`
  - Bug under Feature: `project: "MyProject", parentId: 12345, workItemType: "Bug"`
  - Standalone Feature (no parent): `project: "MyProject", workItemType: "Feature"`
  - Standalone Epic: `project: "MyProject", workItemType: "Epic"`

parentId.description: Parent work item ID. Omit for standalone items (Features, Epics)

folder.description: Override folder path (default: docs/user-stories or AZUREDEVOPS_SYNC_FOLDER)

tools.name: create-user-story-file
tools.description: Create a new user story template file locally. Alias for create-work-item-file with type='User Story'. The file can be edited and then pushed to ADO using sync-work-item-from-file.

parentId.description: Parent Feature ID - the new user story will be created under this feature

folder.description: Override folder path (default: docs/user-stories or AZUREDEVOPS_SYNC_FOLDER)

tools.name: sync-tasks-to-file
tools.description:
Download all tasks under a parent work item (User Story) to a local markdown file. Auto-converts HTML descriptions to markdown. Supports pulling tasks for multiple parents at once.

Examples:
  - Pull tasks for single User Story: `parentIds: [12345]`
  - Pull tasks for multiple User Stories: `parentIds: [12345, 12346, 12347]`

parentIds.description: Parent work item IDs (User Stories) to fetch tasks for

folder.description: Override folder path (default: docs/user-stories or AZUREDEVOPS_SYNC_FOLDER)

skipAutoConvert.description: Skip automatic HTML-to-markdown conversion for task descriptions. Only use when explicitly requested. Default: false

tools.name: sync-tasks-from-file
tools.description:
Push local task changes back to ADO with upsert semantics. Existing tasks (## Task #ID) are updated, new tasks (## NEW TASK) are created. Auto-converts HTML fields to markdown. Requires AZUREDEVOPS_ENABLE_WORK_ITEM_WRITE=true.

Examples:
  - Push tasks for single parent: `parentIds: [12345]`
  - Push tasks for multiple parents: `parentIds: [12345, 12346]`

parentIds.description: Parent work item IDs to sync tasks for

folder.description: Override folder path (default: docs/user-stories or AZUREDEVOPS_SYNC_FOLDER)

skipAutoConvert.description: Skip automatic HTML-to-markdown conversion for task descriptions. Only use when explicitly requested. Default: false

tools.name: get-checklist
tools.description: Get the merged checklist for a work item. Combines the WIT default template with per-work-item state overrides and custom items. Shows completion status for each item.

tools.name: get-checklist-template
tools.description: Get the default checklist template for a work item type in a project. Templates define the standard checklist items that appear on all work items of that type.

workItemType.description:
The work item type name

Examples:

  - Bug checklist: `Bug`

tools.name: list-checklist-templates
tools.description: List all checklist templates configured in a project. Shows which work item types have checklist templates and how many items each has.

tools.description: Get a completion report for checklists across work items. Cross-references checklist data with ADO work items to show which items have incomplete checklists. Results sorted by completion (least complete first).

workItemType.description:
Filter by work item type

Examples:

  - Bug checklist: `Bug`

Filter by work item state (e.g., 'Active', 'Testing', 'Resolved')

tools.name: update-checklist-item
tools.description: Update the state of a checklist item on a work item. When setting to 'Completed', automatically records who completed it and when. Requires AZUREDEVOPS_ENABLE_WORK_ITEM_WRITE=true.

itemId.description: The checklist item ID (from get-checklist response)

state.description:
The new state for the checklist item

Examples:

completedByDisplayName.description: Display name for completedBy (defaults to 'MCP Automation'). Only used when state is 'Completed'.

tools.name: add-checklist-item
tools.description: Add a custom checklist item to a work item's shared checklist. Custom items are visible to all users. Max 128 characters. Requires AZUREDEVOPS_ENABLE_WORK_ITEM_WRITE=true.

required.description: Whether the item is required (default: false)

tools.name: remove-checklist-item
tools.description: Remove a custom checklist item from a work item's shared checklist. Only custom items can be removed (not template items). Requires AZUREDEVOPS_ENABLE_WORK_ITEM_WRITE=true.

itemId.description: The checklist item ID to remove (from get-checklist response, must be a custom item)

tools.name: update-checklist-template
tools.description: Update the default checklist template for a work item type. Replaces all template items. Changes affect all work items of that type immediately. Requires AZUREDEVOPS_ENABLE_WORK_ITEM_WRITE=true.

workItemType.description:
The work item type name

Examples:
  - User Story checklist: `User Story`
  - Bug checklist: `Bug`
  - Task checklist: `Task`
  - Feature checklist: `Feature`

items.description:
JSON array of template items. Each item: {text: string, required?: boolean}. Max 128 chars per item.

Examples:

  - With optional item: `[{"text": "Update release notes", "required": true}, {"text": "Update wiki", "required": false}]`

tools.name: visualize-data
tools.description: Fetch work item data and prepare it for a rich visual dashboard. ONLY use this tool when the user explicitly asks for a visual, chart, dashboard, or graphic representation of their data (e.g. 'visualize', 'show me a chart', 'create a dashboard'). Do NOT use for regular queries — use query-work-items or run-saved-query instead, which are faster. Accepts either a WIQL query or a saved query ID (GUID). After receiving the response, generate a complete HTML snippet following the design system rules, then call render-visualization with the HTML.

wiql.description: WIQL query to fetch work items. Provide either wiql OR queryId, not both. Example: SELECT [System.Id], [System.Title], [System.State], [System.WorkItemType], [System.AssignedTo] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = 'MyProject' AND [System.State] <> 'Removed' ORDER BY [System.ChangedDate] DESC

queryId.description: Saved query GUID. Provide either queryId OR wiql, not both. Found in ADO query URLs: https://dev.azure.com/{org}/{project}/_queries/query/{queryId}/

intent.description: What visualization to create. Examples: 'sprint status dashboard', 'burndown chart', 'team workload by assignee', 'priority breakdown', 'bug trend over time'

maxResults.description: Maximum work items to fetch (default: 20 for visualization)

tools.name: render-visualization
tools.description: Render generated HTML as an interactive visualization in the MCP App. Call this after generating HTML from visualize-data results. Pass the complete HTML snippet — it will be sanitized and rendered in an iframe.

html.description: The complete HTML snippet to render. Must be self-contained with inline CSS and scripts.

title.description: Short title for the visualization (e.g. 'Sprint Status Dashboard')

tools.name: create-test-run

Examples:

testCaseId.description: Link to Test Case work item ID

automatedTestName.description:
Dot-notation test name for filtering/grouping

tools.name: link-test-case

storyId.description: User Story ID to link via Tests/Tested By relation

runId.description: Test Run ID to link via hyperlink

runSummary.description: Comment for the run hyperlink (e.g., '8/8 Passed')

tools.name: get-figma-data
tools.description: Get comprehensive Figma design data including layout, text, styles, and components. Fetches from Figma API and transforms into simplified, AI-friendly format. Can fetch entire files or specific nodes. Automatically deduplicates styles. Supports optimization options to reduce context window usage.

fileKey.description:
Figma file key (alphanumeric string from URL)

Examples:
  - From URL https://figma.com/file/abc123XYZ/...: `abc123XYZ`
  - FigJam board: `Abc123SampleFileKey000`

nodeId.description:
Optional specific node ID(s) to fetch. Format: '1234:5678' or multiple '1:10;2:20'. If omitted, fetches entire file.

Examples:
  - Root node: `0:1`
  - Specific frame: `1234:5678`
  - Section node: `1234-5678`

depth.description: Optional tree traversal depth limit. Useful for large files. Example: depth=3 stops after 3 levels of children.

excludeStyles.description: Remove all styling info (fills, strokes, effects, textStyle, opacity, borderRadius) and globalVars.styles. Useful for understanding architecture without visual details. Default: true. Set to false for full styling data.

tablesToMarkdown.description: Convert TABLE nodes to markdown table format instead of nested node structures. Significantly reduces token usage for tables. Default: true. Set to false for full node tree.

simplifyConnectors.description: Simplify CONNECTOR nodes to just connection endpoints (startNodeId, endNodeId, text). Preserves relationship data while removing visual properties. Default: true. Set to false for full connector data.

simplifyComponentInstances.description: Keep componentId and componentProperties on INSTANCE nodes but remove visual styling. Ideal for ADO User Story components. Default: true. Set to false for full instance data.

extractors.description:
Override which extractors to use. Default uses all.

Examples:
  - Structure only: `layout`
  - Text content: `text`
  - Colors and styles: `visuals`
  - Design system components: `component`

returnFullResponse.description: Set to true to force the full response inline (ignores context-safe threshold). When omitted or false, large responses may be saved to disk with a summary returned instead.

tools.name: get-figma-semantic
tools.description: Extract semantically meaningful data from FigJam boards while discarding positional/visual information. Produces deterministic, diff-friendly output ideal for change detection. Categorizes sticky notes by color, extracts user story IDs, and preserves connector relationships.

fileKey.description:
Figma file key (alphanumeric string from URL)

Examples:
  - From URL https://figma.com/file/abc123XYZ/...: `abc123XYZ`
  - FigJam board: `Abc123SampleFileKey000`

nodeId.description:
Optional specific node/section ID to fetch. If omitted, fetches entire file.

Examples:
  - Root node: `0:1`
  - Specific frame: `1234:5678`
  - Section node: `1234-5678`

stickyColorOverrides.description:
Optional color to category overrides. Map hex colors to categories. ('si-investigation' is a deprecated alias for 'investigation' — output always uses 'investigation'.)

Examples:
  - Blocking issue: `blocker`
  - To be determined: `tbd`
  - Completed item: `done`
  - Informational note: `info`

storyIdPattern.description:
Optional custom regex pattern for extracting story IDs

Examples:
  - Default pattern (US/Story/Task/Bug + number): `(US|Story\s*#?|Task\s*#?|Bug\s*#?)\d+`
  - Simple numeric IDs: `#\d+`

includeScreenshot.description: When true and nodeId is set, returns a 2x PNG screenshot of the node as an image content block alongside the semantic data.

returnFullResponse.description: Set to true to force the full response inline (ignores context-safe threshold). When omitted or false, large responses may be saved to disk with a summary returned instead.

tools.name: extract-ado-stories
tools.description: Extract all ADO User Story Components from a FigJam board or section. Returns structured data with IDs, descriptions, states, parent context, and links. Reduces ~200K raw node data to ~5K structured result.

fileKey.description:
Figma file key (alphanumeric string from URL)

Examples:
  - From URL https://figma.com/file/abc123XYZ/...: `abc123XYZ`
  - FigJam board: `Abc123SampleFileKey000`

nodeId.description:
Optional section node ID to scope extraction. If omitted, extracts from entire file.

Examples:
  - Root node: `0:1`
  - Specific frame: `1234:5678`
  - Section node: `1234-5678`

adoOrganization.description:
Azure DevOps organization name for constructing work item links

Examples:
  - Organization name: `myorg`

adoProject.description:
Azure DevOps project name for constructing work item links

Examples:
  - Project name: `MyProject`

includePlaceholders.description: Include ADO components with placeholder IDs (e.g. 'ADO xxxxx'). Default: false (placeholders are filtered out).

returnFullResponse.description: Set to true to force the full response inline (ignores context-safe threshold). When omitted or false, large responses may be saved to disk with a summary returned instead.

tools.name: download-figma-images
tools.description: Download rendered images of Figma nodes to local disk. Uses the Figma Images API to export nodes as PNG/SVG/JPG/PDF.

fileKey.description:
Figma file key

Examples:

nodeIds.description:
Node ID(s) to render. Semicolon-separated for multiple: '1234:5678;9101:1213'

localPath.description: Local directory path to save images (created if needed)

tools.description: Execute a KQL (Kusto Query Language) query against Application Insights

query.description:

resourceId.description:

timespan.description:
